_doc: UST corpus gate manifest (.scratch/ust-corpus-gate). Selection: the 20 most recent @pifuyuu uploads, skip-and-backfill with reasons in 'excluded'. UST files are never committed (the author's terms forbid redistribution); fetch them with scripts/fetch-pifuyuu-ust.sh. stratum 'vocaloid-original' = any synthesized vocal (VOCALOID/CeVIO/Synthesizer V/UTAU), the gate; 'human-sung' is watched, never tuned against. ust_lead_files = main* plus a sung intro, merged into one reference; ust_other_voice_files = every other voice in the original (harmony, doubling, delay/echo, backing vocalise, spoken), used to find monophonic regions. Timing: stem_time = ust_time + alignment_offset_s. split: 'dev' songs are for iterating/tuning, 'holdout' songs are scored once at the end; assigned by upload order before any tuning (1st, 3rd, 5th… most recent = dev). Split 'holdout2' (added 2026-11-21): a fresh holdout of the next 10 uploads in channel order after the first 21 (2026-10-01 → 10-22), same skip-and-backfill rules; read once to confirm ADR-0016, logged in holdout-reads.jsonl. Split 'holdout3' (added 2026-11-21): a fresh holdout of the next uploads in channel order before holdout2's oldest (2026-08-14 → 09-29), same skip-and-backfill rules (vocaloid-original only; original resolvable and within 1 s of the cover; one integer tempo across lead and other-voice files, grid 16 or 24), plus one: an upload whose UST is not in ust_share_url (Pifuyuu posted it only on BowlRoll) is skipped, because the fetch script reads only that share. 10 songs, all aligned (05), no backfill needed; unread when added. Music frame (utau-edit-cost 10, added 2026-11-24): music_beat_shift_cells and music_bar_shift_cells are the whole cells from the UST's beat lines (resp. its bar lines, every 4 beats from UST tick 0) to the music's beat (resp. the music's bar line), so the music's bar line sits at alignment_offset_s + music_bar_shift_cells × cell, mod one bar. music_frame_status is 'unverified-estimate' (seeded from crates/sona-eval/reports/bar-one.md: drums' beat, harmonic downbeat) or 'ear-checked' (confirmed by listening to a click overlay, sona-eval-frame --clicks). Seeded for the dev split only; absent means the UST's own lines are the only reference. Split 'holdout4' (added 2026-11-24, .scratch/utau-edit-cost/issues/08-holdout4.md): the next uploads in channel order before holdout3's oldest (D-prostrate, 2026-08-14), walked from 2026-08-09 back to 2026-03-24, under holdout3's rules with the grid rule made explicit: at least 90% of the lead's note starts on one grid, 16 or 24 (every earlier corpus song has 91% or more). The walk stops at the first 24 qualifying songs, a count fixed before any alignment so that at least 20 remain if the read-time alignment check flags some (it flagged 3 of 32 earlier songs). Songs that fail only the one-integer-tempo rule (a tempo change, tempos that differ across files, or a fractional BPM) go to split 'holdout4-tempo', also unread, for frame metrics; none did in this window. Every skipped upload is in 'excluded' with its reason prefixed 'holdout4 walk:'. Alignment: sona-eval-ust-align --split holdout4 --no-verify sets alignment_offset_s exactly as for the earlier splits (coarse: singing mask vs vocal-stem loudness; fine: drum-stem phase), but never runs sona's onset detector, so no sona output exists for these songs. alignment_status is therefore 'unverified (…)', which every scorer skips: the onset-delta check (ticket 05) has to be part of the pre-registered read. Unread when added.
ust_terms: https://pifuyuuust.blogspot.com/ — credit the original author, the MIDI author and Pifuyuu; no redistribution (converted formats included)
